Private Taxi & Chauffeur Service in Tabuk

تبوك

Pre-booked private cars from Tabuk — airport pickups at TUU, NEOM (about 180 km from the airport), and Jordan: Aqaba, Petra, Wadi Rum and Amman by the shortest crossing.

The short answer

Taxi Saudi Arabia arranges pre-booked private cars in Tabuk through a vetted partner network. The main trips are Tabuk Airport (TUU) pickups, NEOM (about 180 km from TUU), and Jordan — Aqaba (270 km), Petra (275 km), Wadi Rum (230 km) and Amman (455 km) — using the shortest crossing for each. The vehicle's border fees are included and the fare is agreed before booking.

Tabuk → Aqaba

Tabuk to Jordan

Which border crossing from Tabuk?

We always use the shortest road for your destination in Jordan.

Amman, Petra, Wadi Rum

These go through the Halat Ammar–Al Mudawwara crossing north of Tabuk — the shortest way to inland Jordan.

Aqaba

Aqaba goes through Al Durrah near Haql on the Gulf of Aqaba coast. From Haql the crossing to Aqaba is short.

Tabuk to Jordan — Al Durrah border transfers

Drop at the border — cheaper

If you have your own onward transport in Jordan, we can drop you at the Saudi side of the crossing instead. Ask when you book; how you continue across is your arrangement.

Honest comparison

Tabuk to Jordan: door to door or drop at the border?

Both are available for Jordan — they suit different travellers.

Drop at the Saudi side

  • • You already have transport arranged in Jordan
  • • Travelling light
  • • Lowest fare

Door to door

  • • Family, luggage or elderly passengers
  • • Hotel or airport in Jordan as the end point
  • • One booking for the whole trip

Plan your timing

What changes timing from Tabuk

01

Border queues

Waiting time at Halat Ammar and Al Durrah varies by day and season. Never plan a tight connection on the Jordan side.

02

Long desert legs

Petra, Wadi Rum and Amman are full-day drives. Start early and plan rest stops.

03

Winter mornings

Tabuk is inland and higher than the coast; winter mornings can be cold — dress for it on early departures.

FAQ

Tabuk transport questions

Ask on WhatsApp

Can I go from Tabuk to Aqaba by private car?

Yes, about 270 km via Al Durrah near Haql. The vehicle's border fees are included; each passenger brings a passport and visa. Our Jordan partner covers the Jordan side door to door.

Which crossing do you use for Petra and Amman?

Halat Ammar–Al Mudawwara, the shortest road from Tabuk to inland Jordan.

Can you drop us at the border instead?

Yes, for Jordan — a cheaper option where we drop you at the Saudi side. How you continue across the crossing is your own arrangement.

How do I get from Tabuk Airport to NEOM?

Pre-book a private car: about 180 km. We track the flight and meet you at arrivals.

Is this car rental?

We do not rent self-drive cars — every booking is a car with a professional driver.

Can my company be invoiced?

Yes. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company.
